summary: The audit checks BIOPHYS 241 (or BIOE 300A), BIOPHYS 242, BIOPHYS 250 and MED 255, and 45 graduate units. Every course that fulfills the requirements must be letter graded with a B or better; BIOPHYS 250 and MED 255 are offered only S/NC and still count. The MS is awarded only for part of the Biophysics PhD work.

program.why: Units: "They include completing 45 units of unduplicated coursework after the bachelor’s degree." (the Bulletin's program minimum says 20). Grading: "Courses that fulfill the degree requirements below must be taken for a letter grade. All required courses must be taken with letter grades, except BIOPHYS 250 (C/NC) & MED 255 (P/N). The minimum acceptable grade is B."
